positions.title: Associate Art Director
positions.description:
• Worked on a team to design and develop creative concepts that promote and raise brand awareness through multiple mediums including; web, social media and print
• Designed, managed and implemented creative content on parknicollet.com using Sitecore
• Utilized InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator and Sitecore on a day-to-day basis
• Was responsible for developing social media marketing solutions including Facebook
contests, timeline images and promoted posts

positions.title: Graphic Design Intern
positions.description:
• Worked with a team to design and develop web banners, advertisements, flyers, posters, newsletters, graphics, illustrations, displays and other marketing materials
• Utilized InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator and Adobe Acrobat on a day-to-day basis
• Worked with multiple business and marketing teams to resolve project tickets and
create design solutions to help achieve business objectives
